_description: URL action: selecting a mark opens a URL built from the mark's field values, either in a web page zone on the dashboard or in a browser tab.

action_node._placement: Inside <workbook> > <actions> (see dashboard-filter-action.json for where <actions> goes). Several actions share one <actions> element.

notes.child_order: <activation>, then <source>, then <link>. A URL action has a <link> and no <command>.
notes.field_placeholder: Insert a field value with <[Field Name]>, the field's name in brackets wrapped in angle brackets. The field must be on the source sheet, e.g. on Detail or Tooltip. In the XML the angle brackets are escaped: expression='https://www.example.com/search?q=<[Customer Name]>'.
notes.url_escape: url-escape='true' percent-encodes field values, so values with spaces or & still give a valid URL.
notes.multi_select: multi-select='false' runs the action for one mark. With 'true', values from all selected marks are joined with delimiter.
notes.targeting_a_web_zone: For specific-zone, url-action-target is the numeric id of the web zone (type-v2='web'), not its name. See web-zone.json.
notes.default_target: Omit both url-action-type and url-action-target to get default-zone-or-browser: the URL opens in the dashboard's web zone if there is one, otherwise in a browser tab.
notes.schema_version: url-action-type and url-action-target first appear in the 2019.1 schema. A workbook declaring an older version must omit them.
notes.embeds: Many sites, including youtube.com watch pages, refuse to load inside an iframe. For video, use an embeddable URL such as https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>, or target the browser.
notes.verification: This structure validates against the bundled 2026.2 XSD. Check that the target page loads in a live render. A get-view-image PNG shows web zones as blank.
